summary: Sporting News reviews the 2023/24 Champions League group stage, group by group, showing final tables, results and how each group's qualifiers were decided. Sixteen teams reached the Round of 16, with holders Manchester City, Real Madrid, Bayern Munich and Barcelona among them, while Manchester United and Newcastle United went out. The article also lists the qualified teams and explains the Round of 16 draw on December 18, 2023.
one_line: Group-by-group recap of the 2023/24 Champions League group stage, listing the 16 Round of 16 qualifiers and the draw details.
key_facts: Manchester City could become the first English club since Nottingham Forest in 1980 to successfully defend the Champions League trophy.
Manchester United and Newcastle United were eliminated after finishing bottom of their groups (Groups A and F).

Group A: Bayern Munich (16 points) and Copenhagen (8) qualified; Copenhagen beat Galatasaray 1-0 on the last night via a Lukas Lerager goal, and Bayern beat Manchester United 1-0 through Kingsley Coman.
Group B: Arsenal won the group with 13 points after a 6-0 win over Lens on matchday five; PSV qualified in second place with 9 points.
Group C: Real Madrid won all six games (18 points) including a 3-2 win at Union Berlin; Napoli qualified second with 10 points and Braga took the Europa League spot.
Group D: Real Sociedad and Inter Milan both finished on 12 points after a 0-0 draw at San Siro, with the Basque side top on goal difference.
Group D: Benfica beat RB Salzburg 3-1 in Austria, with Angel Di Maria inspiring them and Arthur Cabral scoring a stoppage-time goal, and progressed to the Europa League on goals scored.
Group E: Atletico Madrid won the group (14 points) by beating Lazio 2-0 on December 13; Lazio qualified second and Feyenoord dropped into the Europa League.

Group F: Borussia Dortmund won the group with 11 points after a 1-1 draw with PSG at Signal Iduna Park; PSG finished second ahead of AC Milan on head-to-head tiebreaker, and Milan took the Europa League spot.
Group G: Manchester City won all six games (18 points), clinching top spot with a 3-2 comeback win over RB Leipzig on November 28; Leipzig finished second.
Group H: Barcelona (12 points) and Porto (12 points) qualified; Porto beat Shakhtar Donetsk 5-3 on matchday six and Shakhtar took the Europa League spot.
The Round of 16 draw takes place in Nyon, Switzerland, on Monday, December 18, 2023 at 12 noon CET (6 a.m. ET).
Each runner-up will be drawn against a group winner, and no team can face anyone from the same country until at least the quarterfinals.
